entities.summary: Phạm Thị Xuân Ban is a Vietnamese writer of short stories, poet and journalist. She published her poetry on her Facebook timeline. Her books I am Woman, 2006, Hey, have you really seen anything?, 2011 were put on censorship ban in Vietnam.
